citations.claim: N approach red with queue 53 and wait 201 at first violating step while EW holds green
N approach already waiting 143 s at red while EW green persists under E detector_fail

counterfactual.change: changed actuated true->false only; fixed-time cycle then serves NS and wait never exceeds 200, so failure disappears

explanation: With actuated control, EW green never terminates despite NS demand waiting >200s. Detector_fail on E hides E queue, and with heavy W arrivals the controller appears to treat EW as needing green / NS recall fails, so EW holds green from before step 820 through step 958 while N/S wait grows 63->143->201, violating max_wait. Fixed-time (same scenario with actuated=false) cycles normally and passes, implicating actuated max-green/recall logic under detector failure.

violation.detail: approach 0 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: The red violating vehicle remains stopped at the intersection entry from step 955 through 958 with no forward progress. The rest of the scene is also frozen with no visible discharge, consistent with one approach waiting indefinitely at red.
